items.headline: OneCore Global patents electronic confirmation format
items.summary: OneCore Global announced a US patent grant covering dynamic-format electronic trade confirmations, per CTRM Center, a step that could affect how CTRM vendors handle automated deal confirmations.

items.headline: Geneva fintech expands commodity trade finance tools
items.summary: Swiss-based FINATRADES Finance SA rolled out three integrated products – FINABRIDGE, FINASWAP and RPAY – covering import financing, gold/commodity-based settlement and cross-border payments, aimed at narrowing the global trade finance gap.

items.headline: ESMA reporting review leaves REMIT scope undecided
items.summary: An ESMA-led holistic review of EU transaction reporting is prioritising fixes to dual-sided EMIR/SFTR reporting, while the option to fold REMIT into a "report once" regime has been dropped from the immediate cost-benefit analysis, per KOR Financial.

items.headline: Baltic Dry Index slips on weaker vessel rates
items.summary: The Baltic Exchange's main dry-bulk freight index fell to its lowest level in nearly a week, with Capesize and Panamax rates easing even as iron ore prices stabilised on steadier Chinese demand, per Baird Maritime.
